task_summary: Revised the separate Chapter 5 Google Doc after structural/voice feedback and user confirmation that technical benchmark tables contain illustrative/sample figures.
key_decisions: Preserved original manuscript and survey; revised only the separate Chapter 5 document.
Retained only 5.1 Summary of Findings, 5.2 Conclusions and 5.3 Recommendations; removed auditor meta-voice, editorial notes and standalone references.
Excluded illustrative technical results; did not claim technical-testing objective achieved.
Calculated sample standard deviations across 71 respondent composite scores, rather than treating 1420 repeated item ratings as independent participants.
lessons_learned: Lesson learned: editorial audit notes must remain outside an academic chapter, and a request for affirmative conclusions does not make sample benchmarks measured results. Prevention runbook/checklist: confirm provenance, retain truthful scope, calculate respondent-level dispersion and review rendered pages.
open_threads: Technical-testing objective requires actual measured test results; original Chapters 3–4 remain unchanged at user direction.
verification_notes: Native readback exactly matches revised text; three main sections, two stakeholder subheadings and 11 numbered items; no sample metrics or editorial artifacts. Three-page PDF rendered and every page visually inspected. Usability mean 4.5309859155/SD 0.3050018966; satisfaction 4.4845070423/SD 0.3450250042; combined 4.5077464789/SD 0.2905226678.
